questions.question: Define the term 'economies of scale' and give two examples. (4 marks)

MegaRetail, a large UK supermarket chain, is considering acquiring a struggling organic food delivery company that has 50,000 loyal subscribers but has been loss-making for two years. Analyse the risks and benefits of this proposed acquisition. (6 marks)
A successful chain of 20 gyms in southern England is considering its growth options for the next five years. Assess the usefulness of Ansoff's Matrix for this decision. (10 marks)

A mid-sized online fashion retailer with strong brand recognition among 18-30 year olds wants to double its revenue within three years. Evaluate whether organic growth or inorganic growth is the better strategy for achieving this goal. (20 marks)
Outline two barriers to entry that might prevent new firms from entering a market. (4 marks)

Source A. Tanjong Bakes is a chain of 40 bakery-cafés in Singapore with 900 staff and a central bakery that supplies every café. Last year its sales were S$60m and its profit S$6m, and it held 8% of the country's bakery-café market. The central bakery makes 20,000 loaves a day at a cost of S$0.80 a loaf; new ovens would let it make 50,000 a day at S$0.62 a loaf. The directors are choosing between two ways to grow. Plan A is to open 15 cafés over two years, each costing S$400,000, paid for from retained profit. Plan B is to take over Golden Crust, a rival with 30 cafés and 6% of the market, for S$36m. Golden Crust's net assets are worth S$20m and it makes a profit of S$3m a year; combining the two chains is expected to save S$1.5m a year. Tanjong Bakes would borrow S$24m of the price at 6% a year. After the takeover the business would have 1,500 staff and 5 layers of management instead of 3. Tanjong Bakes has also agreed to sell frozen dough to supermarkets, which pay 60 days after delivery, while its flour supplier, Straits Flour Mill, must be paid within 30 days. The mill, which Tanjong Bakes pays S$4m a year, is for sale. Calculate the percentage fall in the cost of a loaf at Tanjong Bakes's central bakery if it installs the new ovens. (4 marks)
